home.heroSubtitle: A world of wonder, one animal at a time.
home.aboutText: Tbilisi Zoo is a place where families, kids, and animal lovers come together to learn, laugh, and explore.
home.missionText: Our mission is to protect wildlife through education and conservation. We focus especially on the biodiversity of the Caucasus and on bringing endangered local species back from the brink. And through a space built for curiosity and play, we help every visitor fall in love with the animal world.
home.value1Text: Every animal here is rescued, protected, and loved.
home.value2Text: We teach curiosity, not facts. Discovery first.
home.value3Text: Everything we do is designed for kids and grown-ups.

zebra-001.name: Zebra
zebra-001.kidFact: Zebras have black and white stripes — no two are the same!

lion-001.name: Lion
lion-001.kidFact: A lion's roar can be heard from 5 miles away!

giraffe-001.name: Giraffe
giraffe-001.kidFact: A giraffe's neck has the same number of bones as yours — just seven!

elephant-001.name: Elephant
elephant-001.kidFact: Elephants can smell water from 12 miles away!

rhino-001.name: Rhinoceros
rhino-001.kidFact: A rhino's horn is made of keratin — the same stuff as your hair!

tiger-001.name: Tiger
tiger-001.kidFact: Every tiger has a unique stripe pattern, like a fingerprint!

monkey-001.name: Monkey
monkey-001.kidFact: Monkeys use tools — some even use rocks to crack nuts!

parrot-001.name: Parrot
parrot-001.kidFact: Some parrots can learn over 100 words!

dolphin-001.name: Dolphin
dolphin-001.kidFact: Dolphins sleep with one eye open — half their brain stays awake!

shark-001.name: Shark
shark-001.kidFact: Sharks existed before trees did — over 400 million years!

octopus-001.name: Octopus
octopus-001.kidFact: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood!

cow-001.name: Cow
cow-001.kidFact: Cows have best friends and get stressed when separated!

pig-001.name: Pig
pig-001.kidFact: Pigs are smarter than dogs and can learn tricks!

chicken-001.name: Chicken
chicken-001.kidFact: Chickens can recognize over 100 different faces!

polar-bear-001.name: Polar Bear
polar-bear-001.kidFact: Polar bear fur isn't white — it's transparent and reflects light!

penguin-001.name: Penguin
penguin-001.kidFact: Penguins propose to their mates with a pebble!

arctic-fox-001.name: Arctic Fox
arctic-fox-001.kidFact: Arctic foxes change color — white in winter, brown in summer!

owl-001.name: Owl
owl-001.kidFact: Owls can rotate their heads 270 degrees!

bat-001.name: Bat
bat-001.kidFact: Bats are the only mammals that can truly fly!

raccoon-001.name: Raccoon
raccoon-001.kidFact: Raccoons wash their food before eating it!

spider-001.name: Spider
spider-001.kidFact: Spiders have eight legs and can regrow them if lost!

crocodile-001.name: Crocodile
crocodile-001.kidFact: Crocodiles can't chew — they swallow their food whole!

frog-001.name: Frog
frog-001.kidFact: Frogs absorb water through their skin — no need to drink!

turtle-001.name: Turtle
turtle-001.kidFact: Some turtles can live over 150 years!

eagle-001.name: Eagle
eagle-001.kidFact: Eagles can spot a rabbit from over a mile away!

flamingo-001.name: Flamingo
flamingo-001.kidFact: Flamingos are pink because of the shrimp they eat!

peacock-001.name: Peacock
peacock-001.kidFact: A peacock's tail can have over 200 colorful feathers!
